Page 193 Cont.
Mar. 5 Robert Phillips - 50 - peculiar ringings in head ... Very good man but wonders ...
6 Desire Pomerleau - 49 - in dangerous company ..... hapens to be a re- lative.
Mrs. M Mohan - 30 - ulcers of stomach - troubles of that kind for two yrs .. .
Mrs. Charlotte Hamlin - 61 - Stroke yesterday - unconscious since. Wm. Mcknight - 56 - Episcopelian - serious kidney.
March 7
Mrs. Geo. Allard - 32 - of Milford - very peculiar breast condition - cancer feared. . .
Albert Whitty - 30 - has wife and 2 - very serious domestic trouble .. Otto Schuchard - 61 - in Marine Hospital - pneumonia - and strep.
Page 194 March 10 Thanksgiving - Robert Venuk - 37 - prayed for in sanitorium - four weeks ago - came home yesterday ... after 6 mo.
Mrs. Delphine Frif - 70 - callous feet - suffer fearfully and can hardly walk.
12 Thanks - Mrs. Mary DeFilippi - 70 - had papitation of heart - was not expected to live ... at monastery To-day to thank God and begging for prayers of thanksgiving ...
Isabelle McEvoy - 51 - Gall stones - liver - etc ...
Mrs. Flora Matz - 40 - grave gall-stone - has husband and six child- ren depending on her
George Toth - 20 - parked with heater running gassed till completely exhausted ... Enrolled To-day
Francis Farley
Confrater Valentine Viovote Passionest novice - threatening foot condi- tion - Very promising otherwise from St. Elizabeth Parish ... now in St. Louis, Mo.
